items.classification: FACT about the issued alert; hazard is conditional
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Dense Fog Advisory, visibility one quarter mile or
less in dense fog. For the Heat Advisory, hot conditions with
maximum temperatures in the low-80s to low-90s. Mild minimum
temperatures and weak onshore flow will limit overnight relief.

* WHERE...Northern Monterey Bay.

* WHEN...For the Dense Fog Advisory, until 9 AM PDT this morning. For
the Heat Advisory, from 11 AM this morning to 10 PM PDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...For the Dense Fog Advisory, low visibility could make
driving conditions hazardous. For the Heat Advisory, this level of
heat affects anyone without effective cooling and/or adequate
hydration. Impacts likely in some health systems, heat-sensitive
industries and infrastructure.

items.classification: FACT about the issued alert; hazard is conditional
items.description:
* WHAT...High temperatures up to 103 degrees expected with the
warmest temperatures will be located in the southern San Joaquin
Valley. Overnight lows between 70 and 75 degrees expected in the
Sierra Foothills where the thermal belt is strongest.

* WHERE...San Joaquin Valley and Sierra Nevada foothills.

* WHEN...From 11 AM this morning to 11 PM PDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures may cause heat illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Moderate to major risk of heat-related
illnesses for much of the population, especially those without
effective cooling or hydration.

items.classification: FACT about the issued alert; hazard is conditional
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Extreme Heat Warning, dangerously hot conditions
with temperatures up to 100 expected. For the Wind Advisory, east
winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts to 40 mph expected.

* WHERE...Santa Ana Mountains and Foothills.

* WHEN...For the Extreme Heat Warning, until 8 PM PDT Thursday. For
the Wind Advisory, from 6 AM to 6 PM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result. Heat
related illnesses increase significantly during extreme heat
events.
